component.name: TaskTest
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "runTask" ' Mirrors what a transpiled BrighterScript class instance looks like in `m`: a plain AA ' that cached the global/top nodes in its fields during construction. `m.global` and ' `m.top` are serialized before it, so its copies of them cross as circular references. m.helper = { global: GetGlobalAA().global, top: m.top }
' The same shape one level deeper: references to nodes that live *inside* the `m.top` ' subtree rather than being `m.top` itself — a node-valued field, and a child. payload = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") payload.id = "PayloadNode" payload.title = "payload-from-init" m.top.payloadNode = payload
child = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") child.id = "ChildNode" child.title = "child-from-init" m.top.appendChild(child)
m.descendants = { field: payload, child: child } end sub
sub runTask() print "HELPER GLOBAL TYPE: "; type(m.helper.global) print "HELPER TOP TYPE: "; type(m.helper.top) print "HELPER GLOBAL VERSION: "; m.helper.global.server.version print "HELPER TOP LABEL: "; m.helper.top.label
print "FIELD REF TYPE: "; type(m.descendants.field) print "FIELD REF TITLE: "; m.descendants.field.title print "FIELD REF SAME: "; m.descendants.field.isSameNode(m.top.payloadNode)
print "CHILD REF TYPE: "; type(m.descendants.child) print "CHILD REF TITLE: "; m.descendants.child.title print "CHILD REF SAME: "; m.descendants.child.isSameNode(m.top.getChild(0))
' A write through the script-scope reference has to reach the one real node, so the ' render thread sees it after the task finishes. m.descendants.field.title = "changed-in-task" m.top.result = "ok" end sub
